question: GQ-001
subject: the pre-push hook crossed ten minutes and started timing out my own pushes
symptom: two consecutive pushes killed at the 10-minute mark; the third succeeded only when run in the background
the_blind_spot: check-all.sh reported PASS/FAIL and NO duration, so I could not say which suite had grown without re-running each by hand
the_fix: time every suite in the one run() wrapper both suites pass through, and print seconds on the PASS and FAIL lines alike
reading: load-bearing is 71% on its own and verify is 22% — together 92%. The other three suites cost 41s combined.
why_load_bearing_grows: it replays the entire verify chain once per gate, so every second added to the chain is multiplied by the gate count
not_yet_acted_on: this is a measurement, not a fix — the number is now visible on every run, which is the precondition for deciding whether to act
why_it_matters: a gate too slow to run is a gate that gets skipped, which is how the --quick skip list grew in the first place
